what: The picture drops from 40px above, touches down at 44% of .5s, then at 77% bounces up 8px once more, smaller, and settles — ease-in on the way down and ease-out on the bounce, switching the curve per keyframe for a double ‹tok, tok› touch. Plays once when visible (75% of the screen) or on open·on receiving fx:play. Cutting board·teacup·brand·character entrances

options.from: Height (px number or a value with a unit, negative is above) at which falling starts, default -40
options.delay: Delay (sec), default 0 — stagger several by .08 each and they settle down in turn
options.on: load (on open)·event (when fx:play is sent to the element — repeatable), default once when visible
options.start: ScrollTrigger start for when it becomes visible, default top 75%

from.where: index.css sm-hop — Hero cutting board (.5s) and teacup (.2s later) -40/-8px, How-to-make brand -1.8vw/-.6vw (.33s), closing character -10/-4px (.5s), 6th cut handkerchief -18%

note: The original is a CSS keyframe animation (.5s ease-out forwards) with animation-timing-function changed in each keyframe — the part also runs in CSS, and JS only decides the timing (visible, open, events)
